description: This Swift file defines classes, structs, enums, and functions related to push notification relay registration, including handling challenges, receipts, attestation, and network requests to a push relay endpoint.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptRefreshCoordinator
classes.description: Handles asynchronous refreshing of the app store receipt using SKReceiptRefreshRequest with suspendable continuation.

classes.name: PushRelayAppAttestService
classes.description: Provides methods to create proofs for App Attest, including key generation, attestation, and assertion generation.

classes.name: PushRelayReceiptProvider
classes.description: Loads and refreshes the app store receipt data to be used in push registration.

classes.name: PushRelayClient
classes.description: Main client class responsible for registering push tokens with the relay server, handling challenge fetch, app attestation, receipt management, and HTTP network communication.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Performs the push registration process by fetching a challenge, creating an attestation proof, loading receipt data, and sending the registration request to the relay server.

methods.name: fetchChallenge
methods.description: Requests a challenge from the relay server for push registration.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes JSON data into a specified Decodable type, handling errors.
